decisions.reason: Because these data format plug-ins build directly on the firm’s long-standing geospatial integration know-how and were already productized on their own page, our existing knowledge base gives us strong scope to refine and commercialize them further.

The building digital twin service is related to our geospatial and integration capabilities but is somewhat more application-specific, so while early evidence is limited our R&D and market growth support continued learning rather than withdrawal.

Authentication and identity delegation is close enough to our enterprise GeoIT integration work that we can absorb and improve it, though it is less central than core GIS components and therefore somewhat more exposed if demand stays weak.

An open GIS application development framework fits our software-component, standards, and engineering strengths very closely, making it a product where our absorptive capacity and internal R&D strongly favor continuation.

This identity and access service is tightly aligned with our aim of embedding GeoIT into broader enterprise systems, and the explicit launch positioning suggests enough strategic commitment to keep developing it rather than remove it.
